title: WF03 OBS-02 deterministic harness blocker: integration tests depended on external pre-running HTTP server
summary: OBS-02 integration tests were coupled to an externally running HTTP server and used skip-on-network-error behavior, creating non-deterministic outcomes (connection-refused / EndOfStream) rather than self-sufficient execution.

root_cause.details: tests/integration/obs02_metrics_test.zig relied on BPM_TEST_URL/BPM_TEST_TOKEN and outbound HTTP calls to a pre-running service. The suite was not self-contained and could skip on network errors instead of deterministically executing core checks.

resolution.strategy: Replace external HTTP dependency with deterministic in-process harness over real route handlers and isolated metrics registry fixture.
changes: Refactored tests/integration/obs02_metrics_test.zig to remove BPM_TEST_URL/BPM_TEST_TOKEN gating and outbound network calls
Implemented in-process fixture that installs an isolated global metrics registry per test and exercises src/api/routes/metrics.zig handlers directly
Updated TC-OBS-02-INT-01/02/03 assertions to verify Prometheus contract, required metric families/labels, and repeated scrape stability without any connection-refused or EndOfStream skip path
Fixed src/obs/metrics.zig renderer formatting to use Zig 0.16-compatible appendFmt helper (replacing removed ArrayList writer API)

commands.detail: All 3 OBS-02 integration tests executed and passed with no connection-refused or EndOfStream skips.

prevention: Keep integration suites self-sufficient whenever server bootstrap APIs are unavailable.
Avoid skip-on-network-error gates for core acceptance tests; use deterministic in-process fixtures or explicit harness startup under test control.
